fit_reason: Whole 19-foot deck boat with trailer listed in boats by owner by a private seller.
findings: Burgundy lower hull/transom gelcoat looks somewhat flat and dull compared to the white topsides, especially on the transom around the drive
White topsides look fairly clean and reasonably glossy from these distances
Interior vinyl seats and gray floor appear clean, with some light dust or dirt on the cockpit floor and in the walkway
Bimini canvas looks faded in spots on top
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the Tahoe deck boat and it looks well kept. The burgundy gelcoat on the transom and lower hull looks a bit flat in the photos, and a polish would bring the color back up before buyers see it. We do pre-sale gelcoat polish and interior cleanups and come to you. Would you like a quote?
